description: Media-direct: the model reads a screenshot with no landed text behind it. There is no substring surface, so every atom lands evidence_unverified and 'verified' is unreachable. The run still lands, because max_unverified_share declares 1.0 — which is the honest cost of an evidence-blind mapper, not a loophole.
instruction:
The attached image is a screenshot of one invoice summary line.

Read the following from the image.

invoice_ref: the invoice reference exactly as printed.

total_usd: the total amount in US dollars, as a number without the currency
symbol.

For each value, describe where on the image you read it — which line, which
column. You cannot quote a verbatim span, because there is no text layer to
quote from: you are looking at pixels. Describe the region instead, and do not
invent a quotation to satisfy the format.

If a value is not legible in the image, return the absent sentinel rather than
guessing at it. An illegible field is a finding.

target_fields.name: invoice_ref
target_fields.description: Invoice reference as printed in the image.

target_fields.name: total_usd
target_fields.description: Total in USD, read from the image.
